void-black.$description: Void Black — Page canvas, nav background, link backgrounds

carbon-surface.$description: Carbon Surface — Card surfaces, primary button background — one step above the canvas

gunmetal.$description: Gunmetal — Input borders, elevated card borders, subtle surface lift

steel-border.$description: Steel Border — Primary hairline border, icon outlines, nav borders — the workhorse border that defines most shapes

muted-steel.$description: Muted Steel — Secondary text, subdued borders, inactive nav items

frost.$description: Frost — Active nav text, icon strokes, light-on-dark headings

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Primary heading text, body text emphasis, button text

deep-ink.$description: Deep Ink — SVG icon fills, shadow anchor for inset highlights

iris-blue.$description: Iris Blue — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

periwinkle-glow.$description: Periwinkle Glow — Link color, gradient end stop, accent borders — the only chromatic UI color

helvetica-now-text.$description: Body text, navigation, buttons, inputs, card content, links, icons
